versions.changelog:
Initial release – quickly turn rough visual ideas into precise, production-ready prompts for image, video, NFT, sprite, and campaign workflows.

- Translates vague or emotional requests into structured prompts for visual generation tools.
- Includes step-by-step workflow for extracting key visual intent and context.
- Adapts output to target use: image, video, NFT, sprite, ad, etc., with dedicated sections and rules per type.
- Provides a standardized output format to ensure clarity and reduce wasted generations.
- Contains guidelines for clarifying questions, inferring defaults, and common fixes to improve creative briefs.
- Focuses on specificity, consistency, and practical handoff to creative and generative tools.
